title: Ore Generators
description: Do you have a lack of some resources? If you build a generator you will be set!
body:
This mod adds ore generators that make resources over time

# Features
## Generators:
- Coal
- Copper
- Iron
- Gold
- Diamond
- Nether quartz
- Netherite

Also adds some fun advancements to get by crafting the generators

You need redstone to power them

The generators have hopper compatibility
### Notes
- This is my first mod
- This is all 3-D modeled by me
- This is also all coded by me

# Change log
### 2.0: 
- Made it compatible with 26.1.x 
- Changed the recipes to match the minimum pickaxe level to mine the ore
